title: s07 m2 (seminar + alley, v7 x12 picture, 1000 frames = 33.333 s): music treatment per conspiracy m4c
notes: Treatment = conspiracy m4c (film/conspiracy 70fecfa, music-m4.py): cue mono fold, high-pass 100 Hz, high shelves 6 kHz -6 dB and 11 kHz -8 dB, normalised to -18 LUFS; under speech the cue sits at -29.3 LUFS (m4c's '+9'), 5 dB higher between words; sidechain from the dialogue (10 ms RMS key -44..-38 dBFS, 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release); no breakpoints, swells, dips, guard trim or minimum-gap logic. Program -16 LUFS, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP before AAC (finish-m3.py); AAC 192k on master and phone.

Plan unchanged from s07-m1 (e14f446): seminar dry (cue sheet); noir reprise (suno-5-noir-a) one uncut segment, cut in at track 17.203 s at scene 25.800 s, the hard cut to the alley on frame 774 (5 ms raised-cosine head fade), bar 5 (loop point) on the cut; bar 7 (track 24.484) lands 33.081; raised-cosine fade 33.14 to the last frame (33.333).
Start: the cue enters on a picture event (the hard cut seminar -> alley, frame 774); the seminar stays dry by plan; not moved.

Intro: the used span (bars 5-7, track 17.203-24.736) does not start quiet: 3 s short-term median of the filtered cue -18.67 LUFS over the span, -19.19 over its first 2 s, -18.27 over the whole cue (span within 0.4 dB, its start within 0.9 dB); no intro levelling.

Highs: spectral check of the used span (100 Hz high-passed, Welch 16384 and STFT 4096 high-band frames, spike = bin over its +-400 Hz median): no tonal spike >= 8 dB above 12 kHz. The scan's one 8.1 dB reading (19,992 Hz, high-band frames) is the cue's brick-wall low-pass edge at 20.02 kHz, not a tone: the +-400 Hz median reaches into the empty band above the edge (-102 dB/bin vs -85 below); against the bins below it the bin is 0.6 dB up. Below the edge the largest is 6.8 dB at 16.68 kHz (long-term). No notch.
Effects as m1 (each file gained to -20 LUFS event loudness + gain, hit on its frame); stamp rule: VERSION 3 stamp -6 -> -8 dB. Projector clicks and the slot clack stay -6 dB.

guard.note: measured and reported, not enforced (as conspiracy m4)
